premise: Where should the new seedling live? Engineer tests the sunny spot by the solar panel — too hot; the shadow by the ice — too cold; the greenhouse — just right.
inspiration: Goldilocks and the Three Bears (Southey), turned: the three tries are for someone small's sake, with a thermometer.
lesson: Taking care means finding what someone else needs.
learning: On the Moon it's scorching in sunlight and freezing in shadow: there is no air to share the warmth.

en-US.title: Just Right
en-US.text: Where should the new {seedling:enter} seedling live? {engineer:enter} {engineer:face happy} Engineer took out her thermometer to find out. First she tried the sunny spot by the {solar-panel:enter} solar panel. {engineer:go to solar-panel} {solar-panel:live} The panel tilted up, glinting. {engineer:face surprised} The thermometer shot up. Too hot! Next she tried the shadow where the {ice:enter} ice lay. {engineer:go to ice} {ice:live hold} A wisp of frost curled up off it. {engineer:tint #9AD0FF} Brrr. The thermometer dropped right down. Too cold! On the Moon there's no air to share the warmth around: scorching in sunlight, freezing in shade. {engineer:face sad} {seedling:wobble} Last of all, she tried the {greenhouse:enter} greenhouse. {engineer:face happy} Warm. Bright. Just right. [happily] So that's where the seedling lives. {seedling:live} And every morning, it reaches up to say so.

es-ES.title: Justo lo que necesitaba
es-ES.text: ¿Dónde viviría el {seedling:enter} brote nuevo? {engineer:enter} {engineer:face happy} Ingeniera sacó su termómetro para averiguarlo. Primero probó el sitio soleado junto al {solar-panel:enter} panel solar. {engineer:go to solar-panel} {solar-panel:live} El panel se inclinó, destellando. {engineer:face surprised} El termómetro se disparó. ¡Demasiado calor! Luego probó la sombra donde estaba el {ice:enter} hielo. {engineer:go to ice} {ice:live hold} Un hilito de escarcha subió de él. {engineer:tint #9AD0FF} Brrr. El termómetro bajó del todo. ¡Demasiado frío! En la Luna no hay aire que reparta el calor: al sol, abrasa; a la sombra, hiela. {engineer:face sad} {seedling:wobble} Por último, probó el {greenhouse:enter} invernadero. {engineer:face happy} Calentito. Luminoso. Justo lo que necesitaba. [happily] Por eso el brote vive allí. {seedling:live} Y cada mañana se estira para decirlo.
